_comment: Guardrail budgets enforced by CI. Only the Director may raise these, with a DECISIONS.md entry explaining why.

playerFrameMs._comment: Real players' frame times from telemetry (#373), held by the studio-health watchdog (scripts/playerTelemetry.cjs): a level whose median phone-session p95 frame time over 24 h (3+ sessions) is above touchP95 gets a studio-health issue. 33.4 ms: the VISION bar is 60 fps on a mid-range phone, and a p95 past two vsyncs means visible stutter.

smokeSeconds._comment: Wall time of each CI smoke shard (e2e/shards.mjs), checked by the smoke on CI (#353): 1.5x the slowest CI run on #411 (2026-11-07, the PR depth of #372: four runs, ui and menus one; runs swung up to ~60%), rounded up to 30 s, ui and menus to 120 s; mobile 1.3x. Over budget is a warning; a shard fails only past 1.5x it (scaled up for a slow runner, e2e/shardTime.mjs, #487).

scene._comment: Per-level ceilings checked by the smoke (#188): drawCalls at the ride screenshot (camera-dependent: +20% over the higher of two runs on 2026-10-31; level4 and level5 hold the VISION bar of 250, #260), scene and track (objects named track*) objects and triangles from sceneStats() (camera-independent: +15%). knownOver: "#<open issue>" turns a failure into a warning until that issue lands. Since #925 a target counts only when the rider can shoot it (`sight()`: in view, readable, in sight) on a run played as a player (3 hits a game second), and `bossFramedShare` is the least share of the boss fight with a shootable weak point. Levels 1–5 re-set on 2026-11-23 from their first CI run under that count (seed 1337): the longest gap +1 s and the share +2 points up to the next 5% (both a little more where two runs differed), the boss floor 5 points under, down to the next 5%, so nothing gets worse; the targets are 3 s, 10% and 0.6 (#937). title (#376): the title scene, its drawCalls at the two title screenshots, objects and triangles; raised by the Director on 2026-11-09 for the title world (#436 → #454 / #459, DECISIONS "Week 4"): 140 / 130 / 60 000 are ceilings for a dense instanced park, not targets (was 114 / 89 / 11 356 = the 7 Nov scene +20% / +15%). level1 (200: the lift hill's balloon rings in the 10 s shot, #955) and level3 (98: the Ocean ride's first lift looks over the lagoon, #895) raised by the Director on 2026-11-24. level6 raised by the Director on 2026-11-16 (DECISIONS "Week 5"): 130 draws / 160 objects (was 60 / 110, its first smoke before climbers, the Medusa on screen and the fire; #554, #557, #583), still under the VISION bar of 250.

pacing._comment: Time with nothing to shoot over a whole run, per level (#450): the smoke's nightly `pacing` step (e2e/pacingMetric.mjs) fails a level whose longest gap with no shootable target on screen (seconds of level time; the first 2 s after GO and the boss tell left out) or share of the run with none is over these. Set on 2026-11-09 from the higher of two local runs per level (seed 1337, 0.5 s steps; a level's longest gap moved up to 2 s between runs, its share up to 5 points): the longest gap +1 s, the share +2 points rounded up to the next 5%, so today's levels pass and nothing gets worse. Lowered for level4 and level5 by the wave placement fix (#451) on the same rule from its measured runs. The Director lowers them further. knownOver: "#<open issue>" turns a failure into a warning until that issue lands; with knownOverOnly: "boss" only the boss floor warns (level6 until #926: its gap and share on the #925 rule from its first played CI run, 16.0 s / 71%, its boss floor on the target). level7 (no boss) on the same rule from two seeded `npm run review` runs (57%, longest gap 5.8 s, the tail after the finale).
